tools.name: get_policy
tools.description: Look up the signed-in member's insurance policy: plan name, status, effective and renewal dates, deductible and how much of it is met, out-of-pocket maximum and amount spent, and number of dependents.

member_id.description: The member ID from the session context, e.g. BM-10200.

tools.name: check_coverage
tools.short: Is a service covered; copay, coinsurance, limits.
tools.description: Check whether a service is covered under the member's plan and on what terms: copay, coinsurance, whether it counts toward the deductible, referral or prior-authorization requirements, annual visit limits, and out-of-network terms.

service.description: Service category. Map the member's words to the closest category (e.g. 'eye exam' -> vision_exam, 'therapy for anxiety' -> mental_health, 'skin check' -> dermatology, 'cardiologist' -> specialist).

tools.name: get_claim_status
tools.short: Status of one claim, or the member's recent claims.
tools.description: Get the status of a claim: billed and covered amounts, status (submitted, in_review, approved, paid, denied), denial reason, and expected decision date. Pass claim_id for one claim; omit it to list the member's recent claims.

tools.name: file_claim
tools.short: Submit a new claim for a past visit.
tools.description: File a new claim for a service the member already received. Requires the provider, the service date (YYYY-MM-DD, not in the future), the service category and the billed amount in dollars. Returns the new claim ID.

tools.name: find_provider
tools.short: Search providers by specialty and city.
tools.description: Search for providers by specialty, optionally limited to a city and to providers in the member's network. Returns up to 5 matches with provider ID, name, clinic, city, network status, whether they accept new patients, and working days.

city.description: Optional city, e.g. San Jose. Use the member's city when they say 'near me'.

tools.name: book_appointment
tools.short: Book a new appointment with a provider.
tools.description: Book an appointment for the member with a provider on a date (YYYY-MM-DD) and time (HH:MM, 24h, on the half hour between 09:00 and 16:30). If the time is omitted, the earliest free slot that day is used. Fails with the available times if the slot is taken or the provider doesn't work that day.

reason.description: Optional short reason for the visit.

tools.name: reschedule_appointment
tools.short: Move an existing appointment to a new date/time.
tools.description: Move one of the member's upcoming appointments to a new date (YYYY-MM-DD) and optionally a new time (HH:MM, 24h). If the time is omitted, the original time is kept when free, otherwise the earliest free slot that day. Fails with the available times if the provider doesn't work that day.

appointment_id.description: Appointment ID from the session context, e.g. APT-7001.

tools.name: escalate_to_human
tools.short: Hand off to a human agent (appeals, complaints, medical).
tools.description: Hand the conversation to a human support agent. Use for claim appeals, complaints, billing disputes, anything medical (diagnoses, medications, treatment advice), or when the member asks for a person. Returns a ticket ID and expected response time.

summary.description: One or two sentences for the human agent.
